title: Separate reported Binance phase-one start from XRP-specific withdrawal success; keep aggregate replacement capital separate from XRP demand; repair archive schema and pointers
context: Reuters reports phase one began after 06:00 GMT, BTC withdrawals resumed, and XRP is among 15 phase-one assets. Binance Update #4 lists XRP for progressive availability.

Reuters reports Binance bought approximately $6B of replacement tokens using company funds; funding sources include SAFU/bitcoin reserve, Futures Insurance Fund and treasury. The XRP-specific component is undisclosed.
The Binance status page rendered no records at the 07:07 capture; no XRP-specific successful withdrawal was independently observed.

PR #1450 exact-head archive validation failed because six latest shard pointer entries lacked path/git_blob_sha, the referenced shard wrappers used incorrect record_type/archive_schema_version/array_name metadata, archive_policy counts remained stale, and latest_snapshot omitted record_type snapshot_reference/index_format_version.
decisions: Classify Binance phase-one start as Reuters-reported and company-announced; BTC withdrawals are reported resumed; XRP is included in the first phase but XRP-specific successful withdrawal remains unverified.
Record approximately $6B replacement-token purchases as aggregate company-reported capital, not XRP-specific buying or proof of XRP market demand.
Preserve Binance's 95% aggregate recovery and top-ten 100% backing claims as company-reported; do not infer XRP-specific acquisitions.
Keep the 1B XRP escrow event tracker-reported; Destination and subsequent disposition remain unknown.

Repair the six malformed archive shard wrappers using the required xrp_research_ledger_archive_shard schema; add path/git_blob_sha to pointer entries; reconcile archive_policy arrays and make latest_snapshot a valid snapshot_reference.
Keep PR #1450 draft/unmerged until exact-head archive validation and fail-closed gate pass. No merge or manual dispatch.
ingestion_contract: Record Reuters publication time 06:49 UTC separately from retrieval time; classify its operational status details as reporting of Binance statements/status page.
Capture successful XRP withdrawal transaction evidence or asset-specific Binance status; do not equate BTC resumption with XRP availability.
Separate aggregate replacement purchases, SAFU drawdown, company reserves and any XRP-specific purchases in the capital-flow ledger.
Require archive shard record_type xrp_research_ledger_archive_shard, archive_schema_version 1.0, array_name, chunk_index/count, record_count and records; require pointer path and git_blob_sha.
Require archive_policy arrays, ledger_metrics, latest_snapshot pointer and immutable snapshot file to reconcile before validation.
unresolved: XRP-specific successful withdrawal and current asset-level status.
XRP-specific component of Binance's approximately $6B aggregate replacement purchases.
Raw escrow Destination fields and subsequent disposition.
Full repository CI, dependency scan and security-alert review.
Archive exact-head revalidation after schema/pointer repair.

feature_admission.reason: The Reuters phase-one report and aggregate replacement purchases do not establish XRP-specific transactions or capital flows.
